description: Fetch comments on a DEV.to article. Uses the public Forem API first and falls back to extracting visible comments from the article page when the API is unavailable.

parameters.name: article_url
parameters.description: Full DEV.to article URL, e.g. https://dev.to/{username}/{slug}. Provide this OR article_id.

parameters.name: article_id
parameters.description: Numeric DEV.to article id. Provide this OR article_url.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of top-level comments to return (1-1000, default 50). Applied client-side because the API does not paginate.

parameters.name: include_children
parameters.description: Whether to include nested replies under each top-level comment (true | false, default true).
